sources.citation: Wikipedia (en). 'Kho'ini dialect' (raw wikitext, downloaded 2026-09-17); a digest of Yarshater 2002/2003, its only reference
sources.note: Second-hand and morphological only: abstract nouns take 'a stressed -i'; preterite of intransitives = 'past stem (the stress falling on the last syllable of it) + the present tense of to be'; past participle/progressive = past stem + 'a stressed -a'. No general word-stress rule.

sources.citation: Skjaervo, P. O. 'IRAN vi(2). Documentation', Encyclopaedia Iranica online, extracted from the 2020 Iranica siterip (archive.org item 'iranica')
sources.note: Nothing on Xo'ini stress. The siterip's index of 15,352 Iranica articles (2020) contains no Xo'ini/Kho'ini entry, so the 'Encyclopaedia Iranica article on the Xo'ini dialect' named by the earlier scan could not be confirmed to exist; iranicaonline.org itself is an automated-access block-403 and has no archived copy at the Internet Archive.

sources.citation: Yar-Shater, Ehsan. 1969. A Grammar of Southern Tati Dialects. The Hague: Mouton (Open Library search-inside snippets)
sources.tag: not read: abstract or record only
sources.access_detail: a digital copy exists, behind a library sign-in (archive.org lending); also held in print at Harvard (Widener Library, call number 3263.400.10) (also digitized at HathiTrust, search-only (in copyright))
sources.note: Snippets show the introduction explicitly EXCLUDES Xo'in from the Southern Tati group ('the dialect spoken in Xo'in, 60 kms. southwest of Zanjan.. do not really belong to this group'), so its stress chapter (§82 'Word stress is distinctive in Southern Tati') does not describe Xo'ini.
